description:
## Context

With `Renderer` as a pure module (child 1), the `RenderLoop` Task owns the renderer struct directly and drives it on a fixed-interval clock. This replaces `RenderThrottle` entirely.

## Implementation

### Module: `OctoPi.TUI.RenderLoop`

```elixir
defmodule OctoPi.TUI.RenderLoop do
  alias OctoPi.TUI.{Renderer, Terminal}

  @tick_ms 16

  def start_link(opts) do
    Task.start_link(fn ->
      renderer = Renderer.new(width: opts[:width], height: opts[:height])
      deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + @tick_ms
      loop(renderer, opts[:terminal], deadline, nil)
    end)
  end

  defp loop(renderer, terminal, deadline, pending) do
    wait = max(0, deadline - System.monotonic_time(:millisecond))

    receive do
      {:render, lines, cursor_seq} ->
        loop(renderer, terminal, deadline, drain_latest(lines, cursor_seq))

      {:resize, w, h} ->
        loop(Renderer.resize(renderer, w, h), terminal, deadline, pending)

      :stop ->
        :ok
    after wait ->
      renderer =
        case pending do
          nil ->
            renderer

          {lines, cursor_seq} ->
            {bytes, r} = Renderer.render(renderer, lines, cursor_seq)
            if bytes != "", do: Terminal.write(terminal, bytes)
            r
        end

      loop(renderer, terminal, deadline + @tick_ms, nil)
    end
  end

  defp drain_latest(lines, cursor_seq) do
    receive do
      {:render, l, c} -> drain_latest(l, c)
    after 0 ->
      {lines, cursor_seq}
    end
  end
end
```

### Fixed-interval clock

`deadline + @tick_ms` (not `now + @tick_ms`) prevents drift. If a burst renders at t=3 within a t=0..16 window, the next tick is still t=32, giving `pending` a guaranteed slot at t=16 and another at t=32.

### Resize handling

`Renderer.resize/3` sets `previous: nil`, so the next render will be a full redraw — no explicit `force:` flag needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- `RenderLoop.start_link/1` starts a linked Task
- Render messages arriving between ticks collapse to their last frame via `drain_latest`
- Final-frame guarantee: a state sent as `pending` always renders on the next tick boundary even if no further messages arrive
- Resize message triggers `Renderer.resize/3` and next render is full redraw
- `RenderThrottle` module deleted (telemetry events for `render_throttle.skip` and `tui_render` spec updated accordingly)
- Tests cover: burst collapse, final-frame tick, resize-then-render full-redraw
title: Implement RenderLoop Task with fixed-interval 16ms tick and pending-frame guarantee
